newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Colony Capital takes stake in Credicom Asia.
newsitem.headline: Colony Capital takes stake in Credicom Asia.

text.p: The U.S. real estate investment group Colony Capital Inc has taken a stake in Credicom Asia, a unit of Belgian luxury hotels and goods group Credicom NV, the companies said on Sunday.
Colony Capital will invest up to $100 million in Credicom Asia, which manages the Amanresorts luxury international hotel chain, they said in a statement.
Private investor Donald Sturm, an industrial management and development specialist, will finance up to 25 percent of the stake, they added.
They will make an initial investment of $55 million for a 30 percent stake in Credicom Asia -- $40 million for existing shares in Credicom NV and $15 million for new shares in Credicom Asia.
They will invest a further $20 million by the end of 1997, taking their stake to 37 percent. They may also invest a further $25 million for the Ermitage Hotel in Los Angeles, the companies said.
